name: Women's Corporate Service Dress: navy blazer, white shirt with tie tab, gray skirt (blank nametag)
size_basis: Silhouette traced from Vanguard's product photo of the CAP women's blue blazer (CAP4200E; the photo hangs a little lopsided, so one half is smoothed and mirrored) and scaled so that the blazer is 27.5 in from collar to hem (an estimate: 18.72 in sleeve-to-sleeve, the sleeves hanging close to the body as in the photo). Lines, skirt flare and crest position are read off CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.15 (page 89) and Fig 4.13 (page 85). No real garment was measured. Chest geometry: the crest centre is 4.47 in from the centre line (the miniature rack 3 across, 2.06 in, centred on it has its inner edge 3.44 in out); the lapel's outer edge is 4.85 / 4.55 / 3.73 / 2.89 in from the centre line at y 5.4 (peak) / 6.7 / 8.3 / 9.9 in, so it crosses the top 3.5 in of the rack and clears it from y 8.9 down. Fig 4.13 draws the rack the same way, its left edge on the lapel edge. The arm seam is 5.4 in out at the crest's height, 0.9 in from the crest centre, so the crest and rack cannot move out; see DECISIONS.md DORAN5-ART-2.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons and polylines are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. lapel_left / lapel_right: the lapel-foreground faces (wearer's left is +x); arm_seam_left / arm_seam_right: the armhole seam from the shoulder point down to the chest; shoulder_left / shoulder_right: the top edge of the shoulder from the neck to the sleeve head
documented: navy single-breasted blazer, two or three buttons, notched lapels; pockets optional, no patch pockets (CAPR 39-1 4.2.4.1)
CAP Crest on the left breast pocket or in the same relative position (4.2.4.1.1.1)
nametag top edge aligned with the top of the left breast pocket, or 1/2 inch above the CAP Crest if the blazer has no pocket (4.2.4.1.1.2)
white aviator shirt or blouse with straight collar and blue inverted-V tie tab, the tab under the collar leaves (4.2.4.2-4.2.4.3)
medium gray slacks or straight/A-line skirt (4.2.4.4-4.2.4.5)
assumed: line positions read off the figure
skirt drawn as in the figure; slacks are a bottoms variant
skirt flare: 12 px of half-width per 100 px of height measured on Fig 4.15, applied from the coat side hem to the box bottom

skirt waist and waistband sizes (waist 3.5 in above the coat hem, 1.1 in narrower each side than the hem, 1.5 in waistband): the regulation gives no skirt dimension and the figure hides them under the coat
shirt placket button size (0.14 in radius) and spacing (2.3 in)

collar leaf and neckband shape and size: Fig 4.15 draws only the scooped neckline and the tab (no collar), so the straight collar of 4.2.4.2.1 is built on it: leaves from the lapel tips to the neck over the tab corners, neckband between them
skirt gray #736f6c: the same medium gray as the aviator-shirt slacks and the men's blazer trousers (4.2.4.5, 4.2.5.1.5); the figure sample was #807d7b
skirt side shade (about 16 percent at the edges): the figure draws the skirt flat; no seam, pleat or vent because 4.2.4.5 forbids pleats and slits
